name: 2015-16 Guidance Counselor Reporting - Social Worker Data
description: This dataset contains reporting data on social workers and guidance counselors in New York City public schools for the 2015-16 school year. Each row corresponds to a school or location, identified by its DBN (District Borough Number) code, and includes the location name and type. The data breaks down staffing counts, including total social workers and guidance counselors, full-time and part-time staff, bilingual staff, and staff serving more than one location. An ATR field is also included. With 1,644 rows, the dataset can be used to analyze staffing levels and resource allocation across schools, compare full-time versus part-time and bilingual support, identify locations with staff spread across multiple sites, and support research or reporting on student support services in the district.
